title: Employ only registered teachers
what: Appoint, employ or engage a person to teach at an educational institution only if the person is a registered teacher.

sources.title: Teacher Registration Act 2012 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not appoint, employ, engage or give permission to another person to teach at an educational institution unless the other person is a registered teacher.
